title: Brex - Approval friction is the most-cited complaint on G2
clean_text: On G2, "Approval Issues" is the single most-mentioned complaint category, with 49 mentions covering miscategorized purchases and inadequate onboarding, and 55 mentions specifically citing approval-process challenges for smaller businesses. Other frequent complaints include receipt-scanning and virtual card upload issues (25 mentions), card payment denials and spending-category limitations (24 mentions), and cumbersome manual entry that users say needs better integrations (26 mentions). In 2022, Brex systematically closed accounts across its small-business segment, with affected users receiving notices that Brex could no longer offer service due to a change in account eligibility criteria.
